jobs.occupation: Associate professor in Artificial Intelligence for Medical Applications at SDU Robotics
jobs.description:
To support our advancements in deep learning and AI methods for medical image and clinical data analysis SDU Robotics invites applications for one or more associate professor position(s). The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

• 
An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

 

Job description
The successful candidates will contribute to the unit’s current and future research projects and teaching activities. Key responsibilities include, for example to:

• 
Be able to collaborate with our experts and colleagues from SDU Robotics in the further development of our core technologies. 

• 
Be deeply involved in our regular coordination and joint evolvement of research and project activities. 

• 
Raise funding and manage research projects. 

• 
Design and conduct lab experiments. 

• 
Participate in the practicalities of actual industrial applications. 

• 
Organize, plan and conduct excellent teaching for undergraduate and graduate courses. 

• 
Independently supervise project courses, and BSc, MSc and PhD thesis projects. 

The position as an associate professor involves primary responsibilities related to research (including the obligation to publish and disseminate scientific knowledge) and research-based teaching (including examination duties) – research and teaching obligations equally. Additionally, the role may encompass knowledge exchange with society, including participation in public debates. Furthermore, it may entail responsibilities such as research management, curriculum development, guidance, supervision, and scholarly assessment. The university determines the specific allocation of tasks, and the emphasis on these tasks may vary over time.

 

Profile and requirements
The candidates will participate in SDU Robotics' comprehensive research, and the position requires research experience within artificial intelligence and deep learning for medical applications. This includes documented knowledge within some of the following technologies/areas:

• 
Deep learning-based classification, segmentation and detection in 2D and 3D medical images.

• 
Machine learning methods for analysis of clinical data.

• 
Explainable and interpretable AI methods for medical decision support.

The candidates must have a relevant PhD degree (e.g. in computer science, engineering or a related field) and are expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

• 
Experience in acquiring and coordinating publicly and/or privately funded projects.

• 
Strong track record of directly engaging with clinical or industrial partners in application-oriented projects and/or a relevant international network for research and collaboration activities.

• 
Experience with teaching and independently supervising project courses, and BSc and MSc thesis projects.

• 
Experience in teaching AI courses for medical image analysis.

Preferably, the candidates have experience with:

• 
Medical image analysis

• 
Analysis of clinical and healthcare data

• 
Explainable AI

• 
Experimental design and validation of AI-based systems

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

• 
Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team. 

• 
Have the ability of working independently.

• 
Have high self-motivation to learn. 

• 
Have a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Have excellent communication skills in English speaking and writing. 

In the assessment of candidates, consideration will be given to: 

• 
Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

• 
Experience in interdisciplinary research collaboration.

• 
Teaching experience.

• 
A relevant international network for research and collaboration activities, research experience abroad.

• 
Experience in attracting funding for research projects and demonstrated experience in research leadership.

 

Research environment 
The candidate will be integrated into the unit SDU Robotics, which is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We are a team of currently appr. 60 researchers and engineers specialized in research and development of robot solutions and advanced robot systems within the medical, welfare and industrial domain. 

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. 

The aim of the group is to solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We participate in implementing the results achieved in real solutions with end users like national hospitals, LEGO, Novo Nordisk and Universal Robots.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

Further information
Further information about this position is available via email from professor Thiusius R. Savarimuthu trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is January 11, 2027, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae including personal contact information.

• 
Research statement with ideas for research and development activities (max. 4 pages).

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates/diplomas (copy of original and in official English translation).

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant for the position. 

• 
Reference and a statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process 

Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Employment as an associate professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor. Employment as associate professor is a permanent position. 

The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

jobs.occupation: Kok til thailandsk køkken / Chef to Thai cuisine
jobs.description:
Kok til thailandsk køkken

Brænder du for det autentiske thailandske køkken, og trives du i et travlt og velorganiseret køkken med høje kvalitetskrav? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Thai 2 You på Nørrebro har vi i 25 år lavet frisklavet, velsmagende thaimad til vores mange faste kunder. Vi søger nu en dygtig og selvstændig kok til at indgå i vores faste køkkenteam.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Tilberedning af autentiske thailandske retter fra bunden (herunder wokretter, karryretter, supper og forretter) efter vores opskrifter og standarder.

• 
Klargøring af de friske råvarer, forberedelse af saucer og forretter, samt tilsmagning.

• 
Varemodtagelse, kvalitetskontrol af råvarer samt medansvar for lagerstyring og bestilling.

• 
Opretholdelse af høj hygiejnestandard og egenkontrol i henhold til Fødevarestyrelsens regler.

• 
Samarbejde med det øvrige køkkenpersonale om en effektiv og god arbejdsdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• 
Har solid praktisk erfaring som kok – gerne med speciale i eller indgående kendskab til det thailandske/asiatiske køkken.

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og det gode humør, når der er travlt i aften- og weekendtimerne.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, hygiejnisk og sætter en ære i, at hver eneste ret forlader køkkenet i høj kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller.

• 
Taler og forstår enten dansk, engelsk eller thai.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast fuldtidsstilling (40 timer om ugen) i en veletableret og sund virksomhed.

• 
En uformel og venlig arbejdsplads med erfarne kollegaer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende vilkår.

• 
Arbejdstider primært i eftermiddags- og aftentimerne samt weekender efter fast vagtplan.

--

Chef to Thai Cuisine

Are you passionate about authentic Thai cuisine, and do you thrive in a busy, well-organized kitchen with high quality standards? If so, you might be the person we are looking for!

At Thai 2 You in Nørrebro, we have been preparing fresh, delicious Thai food for our many regular customers for 25 years. We are now seeking a skilled and independent chef to join our permanent kitchen team.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Preparing authentic Thai dishes from scratch (including stir-fries, curries, soups, and appetizers) according to our recipes and standards.

• 
Preparing fresh ingredients, making sauces and appetizers, and seasoning dishes.

• 
Receiving goods, performing quality control on ingredients, and sharing responsibility for inventory management and ordering.

• 
Maintaining high hygiene standards and internal quality control in accordance with the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration’s regulations.

• 
Collaborating with the rest of the kitchen staff to ensure an efficient and positive workday.

We expect that you:

• 
Have solid practical experience as a chef - ideally with a specialization in, or in-depth knowledge of, Thai/Asian cuisine.

• 
Can maintain a clear overview and a positive attitude during busy periods, such as evenings and weekends.

• 
Work in a structured and hygienic manner, and take pride in ensuring that every single dish leaves the kitchen at a high standard of quality.

• 
Are reliable, responsible, and a good team player.

• 
Speak and understand either Danish, English, or Thai. 

We offer:

• 
A permanent, full-time position (40 hours per week) in a well-established and financially sound company.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with experienced colleagues who support one another.

• 
Salary based on qualifications and applicable terms.

• 
Working hours primarily during the afternoon and evening, as well as weekends, according to a fixed schedule.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager – Production Support & Technical Purchasing, GN Hearing, Præstø
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to manage technical projects that help ensure reliable, compliant, and scalable manufacturing of medical electronic devices? We are looking for a Technical Project Manager within Production Support & Technical Purchasing who will lead initiatives that support production continuity, equipment upgrades, validation activities, and supplier collaboration across our manufacturing environment.

**In the role our new Technical Project Manager in the Component Manufacturing Engineering team under Global Operations, you will connect engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers to deliver robust manufacturing solutions and support uninterrupted production.

**The team you will be part of:

**You will join Component Manufacturing Engineering within Global Operations. The team supports the manufacture of electronic components and assemblies through technical project delivery, production engineering, equipment development, and supplier collaboration.

We work closely across Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners to improve processes, manage change responsibly, and deliver quality outcomes. We value practical problem-solving, clear collaboration, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

**

• Scope and deliver production engineering projects that optimize manufacturing processes, electronic test environments, and assembly-line layouts

• Manage equipment transfers, capacity expansions, and hardware and software upgrades to support stable and scalable production

• Coordinate manufacturing changes and risk assessments with Operations and Quality to help prevent supply chain or production interruptions

• Support the implementation of automated test equipment and calibration protocols for PCBAs and sub-assemblies

• Manage technical sourcing initiatives for manufacturing equipment, tooling, production components, and automated test stations

• Build productive supplier relationships and negotiate agreements covering pricing, lead times, service levels, and statements of work

• Support validation and documentation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ, change controls, SOPs, and audit-ready equipment records

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring a relevant technical degree within electrical, electronic, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering, or a related field

• Have experience managing production engineering, manufacturing, or technical projects within a regulated industry, preferably medical devices, automotive, or aerospace

• Bring knowledge of electronics manufacturing, including SMD production, PCBAs, electronic assemblies, power supplies, or electromechanical components

• Have experience coordinating technical teams and resources, while creating alignment across engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers

• Bring experience with quality frameworks, validation, change management, technical purchasing, and supplier negotiations; knowledge of ISO 13485 is beneficial

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 5 December 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**About The Role

**We're seeking a driven Business Intelligence Analyst to join our FP&A team, reporting to our FP&A Data Lead - someone early in their data career who's eager to help build our new data platform and grow with it, in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you'll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Finance, Commercial teams, Tech and Product Owners. As you grow, you'll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

**Here's a Taste Of What You'll Be Doing

**

**What We Are Looking For In You

• A degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, statistics, engineering, computer science or information systems.

• Some understanding of data modelling (how tables, keys and dimensions fit together), or a clear wish to learn it.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

**Why Join Us?

**

• Help build a modern data platform early in your career, while it is still taking shape, with data that Management uses to make decisions from day one.

• A clear growth path - from learning the platform and supporting the team, to owning metric definitions and how we report.

• Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.

• Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.

• Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.

**Great To Have (But Not Required)

**

• Understanding of database structures and data modelling, such as star schemas and semantic models.

• Understanding of how SQL is used to query, model and transform data.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query.

• Familiarity with finance or commercial concepts, such as cohort modelling.

**What We Do At OrderYOYO

**OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

**Who We Are At OrderYOYO

**Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Genmab is looking for a Senior Manager to join Digital Development and cover a period of parental leave. You will lead the planning, coordination and delivery of digital initiatives, with a primary focus on establishing a streamlined workflow for application delivery. The workflow will connect business needs, development, governance, testing, deployment and operational handover, with clear responsibilities and practical guidance at each stage.

jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

You'll be in charge of building agentic factories that re-think what is possible across product, marketing, implementation, customer service.

• Rethink work from first principles. Take a process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, or product. Ask what outcome it exists to deliver, and redesign it around what AI now makes possible. Making the old process faster is the easy part.

• Own operations end to end. Take full ownership of processes across finance operations, people operations, and legal and compliance, working directly with the Chief of Staff to CEO. Run them, then rebuild them so agents do the work and nothing falls through the cracks.

• Build the agents and workflows yourself. Identify where manual work can be automated or standardised, and build the solution rather than waiting for someone else to do so.

• Move fast. Ship a first version in hours and iterate several times a day.

• Participate in the AI Academy. Complete the specialised AI training, apply what you learn in every function you work in, and share what worked and what didn't so the rest of the cohort and the teams can adopt it.

• Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the team can rely on what you've shipped.

You'll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we're looking for

• Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn't work.

• Kindness. You make the people around you better.

How we'll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: 10 to 1,000x output capacity.

What you'll get

• Full-time compensation above the standard market rate.

• Every tool available. We give everyone in the Academy access to all the AI tools on the market, and put you in the environment that will make you a success.

• A role based in our Copenhagen office, working alongside the teams and the AI Academy cohort.

• Ownership from your first day, with a path to owning a function.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to, or a description of, something you've built. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to join the AI Academy at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you're ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

• 
One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

• 
One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

• 
A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

• 
Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

• 
Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

• 
A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

• 
Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

• 
Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

• 
Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Joan Thygesen

**Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery

**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.
